DETAILED ACTION
This Office Action is a response to an application filed on 01/28/2022, in which claims 1-20 are pending and ready for examination.
Notice of Pre-AIA  or AIA  Status
The present application, filed on or after March 16, 2013, is being examined under the first inventor to file provisions of the AIA .
Information Disclosure Statement
The information disclosure statement (IDS) submitted on 06/23/2022 is in compliance with the provisions of 37 CFR 1.97.  Accordingly, the information disclosure statement is being considered by the examiner.
Claim Rejections - 35 USC § 102
The following is a quotation of the appropriate paragraphs of 35 U.S.C. 102 that form the basis for the rejections under this section made in this Office action:
A person shall be entitled to a patent unless –
(a)(1) the claimed invention was patented, described in a printed publication, or in public use, on sale, or otherwise available to the public before the effective filing date of the claimed invention.
Claims 1-20 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by Zhao (US 2017/0094314 A1).
Regarding claim 1, Zhao discloses: A method for processing video data (see Fig. 1), the method comprising:
extracting a data block from the video data (see Fig. 5, residual block 101);
scanning a first number of data items in the data block following a first scan order to generate a first data sequence (see paragraph 136);
performing a non-separable transform to the first data sequence to obtain a second data sequence having a second number of data items (see paragraph 136); and
replacing at least a portion of the first number of data items in the data block with a portion or all of the second data sequence following a second scan order (see paragraph 147, the respective 4×4 transform coefficient sub-block B may be replaced by a respective derived secondary 4×4 transform coefficient block F).
Regarding claim 2, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 1, wherein:
the data block comprises primary transform coefficient (see paragraph 136);
the non-separable transform comprises a forward non-separable secondary transform (see paragraph 110 and 136 and Fig. 3A, fwdR); and
replacing at least a portion of the first number of data items in the data block comprises replacing the second number of data items within the first number of data items in the data block with the second sequence following the second scan order (see paragraph 147).
Regarding claim 3, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 2, wherein the first scan order is determined based on at least one of:
an intra prediction mode associated with the data block (see paragraph 140);
a type of the forward non-separable secondary transform (see paragraph 139); or
a size of the data block.
Regarding claim 4, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 2, wherein the second scan order is determined based on at least one of:
an intra prediction mode associated with the data block (see paragraph 142);
a type of the forward non-separable secondary transform (see paragraph 142); or
a size of the data block.
Regarding claim 5, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 2, wherein the first scan order or the second scan order comprises one of:
a zig-zag scan order (see paragraph 145);
a diagonal scan order (see paragraph 145); or
a row and column scan order.
Regarding claim 6, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 2, wherein:
the first scan order or second scan order is determined based on an intra prediction mode associated with the data block when a same set of transform kernels are shared by multiple intra prediction modes with respect to the video data (see paragraph 138).
Regarding claim 7, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 2, wherein the first number and the second number are integers between 0 to 127, inclusive (see paragraph 146).
Regarding claim 8, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 2, wherein the first scan order and the second scan order are:
a zig-zag scan order when the data block is a square block (see paragraph 127 and 137); or
a diagonal scan order when the data block is a non-square block (see paragraph 127 and 137).
Regarding claim 9, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 1, wherein:
the data block comprises residual samples (see paragraph 136);
the non-separable transform comprises a forward non-separable primary transform (see paragraph 110 and 136 and Fig. 3A, fwdR); and
replacing at least a portion of the first number of data items in the data block comprises replacing the second number of data items within the first number of data items in the data block with the second sequence following the second scan order (see paragraph 147).
Regarding claim 10, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 9, wherein the first scan order is determined based on at least one of:
an intra prediction mode associated with the data block (see paragraph 140);
a type of the forward non-separable secondary transform (see paragraph 139); or
a size of the data block.
Regarding claim 11, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 9, wherein the second scan order is determined based on at least one of:
an intra prediction mode associated with the data block (see paragraph 142);
a type of the forward non-separable secondary transform (see paragraph 142); or
a size of the data block.
Regarding claim 12, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 9, wherein the first scan order or the second scan order comprises one of:
a zig-zag scan order (see paragraph 145);
a diagonal scan order (see paragraph 145); or
a row and column scan order.
Regarding claim 13, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 9, wherein:
the first scan order or second scan order is determined based on an intra prediction mode associated with the data block when a same set of transform kernels are shared by multiple intra prediction modes with respect to the video data (see paragraph 138).
Regarding claim 14, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 9, wherein the first number and the second number are integers between 0 to 127, inclusive (see paragraph 146).
Regarding claim 15, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 9, wherein the first scan order and the second scan order are:
a zig-zag scan order when the data block is a square block (see paragraph 127 and 137); or
a diagonal scan order when the data block is a non-square block (see paragraph 127 and 137).
Regarding claim 16, Zhao discloses: The method of claim 9, wherein the first scan order is a horizontal or vertical scan order (see paragraph 145).
Regarding claim 17, Zhao discloses: A method for entropy encoding transform coefficients associated with video data, the method comprising:
in response to a transform associated with the transform coefficients being non-separable (see paragraph 93 and 145), scanning the transform coefficient when performing entropy encoding of the transform coefficients using a first scanning order being one of:
a horizontal scan order (see paragraph 145); or
a vertical scan order (see paragraph 145); and
in response to the transform associated with the transform coefficients being separable, scanning the transform coefficient in a second scanning order different from the first scanning order when performing entropy encoding of the transform coefficients (see paragraph 91).
Regarding claim 18, Zhao discloses: 18. The method of claim 17, wherein the transform comprises one of:
a primary transform (see Fig. 5); or
a secondary transform (see Fig. 5).
Regarding claim 19, Zhao discloses: A device comprising a circuitry configured to implement the method of claim 1 (see paragraph 57).
Regarding claim 20, Zhao discloses: A method for processing video data, the method comprising:
receiving the video data (see Fig. 5, residual block 101);
determining whether a non-separable transform is applied as a secondary transform to the video data (see paragraph 91-93, separable and non-separable transform is performed);
in response to the non-separable transform being applied as the secondary transform to the video data (see paragraph 93):
scanning a first number of primary transform coefficients, wherein the primary transform coefficients follow a first scanning order (see paragraph 136);
performing a non-separable transform using the first number of primary transform coefficients as an input to obtain a second number of secondary transform coefficients as an output (see paragraph 136), wherein the secondary transform coefficients follow a second scanning order (see paragraph 145);
replacing at least the second number of primary transform coefficients with the secondary transform coefficients following the second scanning order (see paragraph 147, the respective 4×4 transform coefficient sub-block B may be replaced by a respective derived secondary 4×4 transform coefficient block F);
performing an inverse secondary transform corresponding to the non-separable transform using the second number of secondary transform coefficients as an input to obtain the first number of primary transform coefficients as an output  (see Fig. 5, step 158); and
replacing at least the first number of secondary transform coefficients with the primary transform coefficients following the first scanning order (see Fig. 5, step 166 and paragraph 147).
Conclusion
